title: PinSav3-VM
tagline: Pin Sav3 VM is a decentralized image sharing platform where users can share their pictures on the decentralized storage
description:
Problem
Currently monolithic web applications retain ownership of user content and keep it siloed as a way to wall in users.

Solution
The combination of decentralized storage and creator ownership of intellectual property to introduce new dynamics between content creators and form new more meaningful communities.  
The architecture creates new challenges and opportunities to introduce tools that will facilitate the creation of these communities.
how_its_made:
The project is build using NextJS and React Components. We utilised RainbowKit library to add wallet connection to our dapp.
PinSav3 VM also uses nft.storage and ipfs behind the scenes to store the images and files, in general.
The NFT contract is built using Hardhat, solidity and deployed on Polygon.
We have deployed React version of the app on spheron as well.
